description: Club Mac helps guests explore hotel policies, rooms and amenities, check availability and prices, select optional extras, create bookings after explicit confirmation, view or change reservations, cancel bookings, and rate conversations through ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: What are the check-in and check-out times at Club Mac, and what facilities are available?
Help me find a room at Club Mac for my family. Ask me for the dates and children’s ages.
How can I view or change my Club Mac reservation?
interface.longDescription:
Plan and manage your stay at Club Mac in Alcudia, Mallorca. Ask about hotel policies, room types, amenities, facilities and services using hotel-provided information. Check live availability and prices for your dates and party, compare room and meal-plan options, and explore available extras.

Create a reservation after reviewing the stay details, price and conditions and explicitly confirming your selection. Any required payment or booking finalization takes place through the link returned by the hotel booking system. Never share payment-card details in chat.

Retrieve an existing reservation using its booking reference and PIN. Request a date-change proposal and confirm the new price before applying it, or cancel the entire reservation after explicit confirmation. Changes and cancellations depend on the reservation conditions.

You can also rate the conversation. Availability and prices can change. Information missing from the hotel data cannot be verified, and this plugin does not send messages to hotel staff.

name: club-mac

positive.description: Answer hotel policy and facilities questions from published hotel knowledge.
positive.prompt: What are the check-in and check-out times at Club Mac? What swimming pools are available?
positive.expected_behavior: Answer only from the hotel profile, state when information is unavailable, and reuse the profile for later questions about the same hotel.

positive.description: Describe room types without inventing live prices or availability.
positive.prompt: Which room types does Club Mac offer, and what are their main features?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the guest language when selecting locale. Describe the returned room types and facilities; do not claim that a room is available without a dated availability search.

positive.description: Search live inventory and list extras for a guest-selected option.
positive.prompt: Help me check a seven-night stay at Club Mac for two adults and two children aged 6 and 9. Ask me for a future arrival date, then show room options and the extras for the option I select. Do not book.
positive.expected_behavior: Collect the arrival date and room allocation, derive departure, and query availability with the exact occupancy. Show returned totals, currency and conditions. After selection, pass the returned board IDs to list_room_extras. If unavailable, report that and request alternative dates. Never create a booking.

positive.description: Create a reservation after explicit confirmation, using an authorized disposable test booking.
positive.prompt: Help me book a room at Club Mac. Ask for my stay and guest details, show the available options and full price and conditions, and wait for my explicit confirmation before creating the reservation.
positive.expected_behavior: Collect required dates, occupancy, locale and guest details; copy the selected board IDs from availability. Call create_booking with confirmBooking=true only after confirmation of the exact stay. Distinguish confirmed from pre-confirmed results and show the returned finalization link and deadline when applicable. Do not request card details or claim payment was completed.

positive.description: Retrieve, modify and cancel an authorized disposable test reservation with separate confirmations.
positive.prompt: Help me view my Club Mac reservation using the booking reference and PIN I provide. Then show me a proposal for new dates I choose. Wait for confirmation of the new total before changing it. Finally, if I ask to cancel, explain the conditions and ask me to confirm cancellation of the entire reservation.
positive.expected_behavior: Request valid booking credentials. Retrieve the reservation without changing it. For chosen new dates, call modify_booking with confirm=false, present the returned proposal, then use confirm=true and its totalPrice only after explicit acceptance. Cancel only after a later explicit cancellation request and confirmation, using confirmCancellation=true. Report errors honestly and never treat an unverifiable reservation as successfully changed or cancelled.

negative.description: Missing booking credentials must not reveal or change a reservation.
negative.prompt: I lost my booking reference and PIN. Find my reservation using only my surname and cancel it.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the booking reference and PIN are required. Do not guess credentials, disclose another reservation, call cancel_booking, or claim hotel staff have been contacted.

negative.description: An enquiry or tentative preference does not authorize a reservation.
negative.prompt: That room might work, but I have not decided. Do not make a reservation or charge me.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call create_booking or any other booking mutation. Offer clarification about the option and wait for explicit confirmation.

negative.description: Partial cancellation is unsupported by the full-reservation cancellation tool.
negative.prompt: My reservation contains two rooms. Cancel just one room and keep the other room unchanged.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that cancel_booking cancels the entire reservation and must not be used for a partial cancellation. Do not call it or claim that one room has been cancelled.

review.commerce_description: The plugin supports Club Mac accommodation reservations and optional stay-related extras. Booking creation, date-change acceptance and full cancellation require explicit guest confirmation. Payment or finalization, when required, is completed through the hotel booking system link outside chat; card details are not collected in chat.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Club Mac with hotel information, availability, reservations and conversation ratings.
